title: Clean up the interface between the superelement markers and the superelements
author: Claude-JG
description: MarkerSuperElementPosition and MarkerSuperElementRigid compute their sums over the mesh nodes through a set of functions of the superelements (GetMeshNodeLocalPosition, GetMeshNodePosition, ...); the code is cleaned up and the interface adapted, as the base of the precomputed interface sums (#2184).
releaseNotes: the interface between the superelement markers and the superelements: what a marker needs of its mesh nodes is computed by the superelement at Assemble; a changed weightingFactors takes effect without a new Assemble; the position of MarkerSuperElementPosition with weights that do not sum up to 1 follows the floating frame like that of MarkerSuperElementRigid
